newsitem.title: INDIA: Indian cotton prices fall on new crop arrivals.
newsitem.headline: Indian cotton prices fall on new crop arrivals.

text.p: Indian cotton prices fell on Monday on low mill demand and sharply rising new crop arrivals in producing centres, traders said.
New crop arrivals in Punjab region on Monday jumped to 14-15,000 bales (170 kg each) against the daily average of 8-10,000 bales last week.

In spot deals Bengal-deshi slid by 5/10 rupees to 870/890 rupees per maund (37.32 kg) while Punjab saw-ginned fell by 5/15 rupees to 1,615/1,690 rupees per maund. Gujarat Kalyan (medium-staple) slid by 100/200 rupees to 12,800/13,000 rupees per candy (355.56 kg).
